name: Sinko Industries Ltd.
summary: Sinko Industries Ltd. manufactures, sells, and installs air conditioning equipment in Japan and internationally. The company provides air conditioners, air handling unit, air handling terminal type, air handling compact type; heat pump air handling unit; data center air handling unit; heat exchanger; fan coil unit; and unit heater. It also offers large air volume fan coil unit; and special model fan coil unit. In addition, the company's products are used in central air conditioning systems, offices, factories, hospitals, and hotels. Sinko Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
